d:
A woman moves in.
Sophie has just moved into a newly renovated apartment. But as she pokes around, she stumbles upon an old television stashed away in a locked closet. She sets it up, but as the TV flickers on, it's broadcasting her own image, from an angle that seems impossible to capture her from, much less block, shut off or destroy.
She becomes acquainted with her neighbor Kyle, and both of them are drawn into the mystery of the strange, old television. They begin to suspect that the figure onscreen isn't just a reflection of the "real" Sophie, but something else entirely.
